cap_rule.choice: HARD CAP tren |logits|: capped = 3.0 * tanh(raw / 3.0), hang so cau hinh duy nhat, ap dung moi fold/seed giong nhau
justification: (1) Init-scale: std init ~0.02 (do seed 1729, synthetic probe) -> CAP=3.0 ~140 sigma init: provably non-binding luc khoi dau/hoc som, giu nguyen dynamics v55 trong vung kha di; chi bind khi logits phong (peaked regime = failure mode).
(2) Don dieu elementwise -> ranking intra-decision bao toan chinh xac, ListNet tau=1.0% giu nguyen phia target (khong doi objective nhu adaptive-tau se lam).
(3) Bound test-time theo cau truc: |margin|<=6.0 du raw lon co nao -> threshold tu capped-val van co y nghia duoi shift (dung lo hong giet v38).
(4) Tien le v39 (tanh +-5% tren value head): cung ho cap, khac don vi (logit ordinal vs %); 0 params them, gradient-friendly (khong vung bang nhu clip).
(5) Hang so co dinh, khong fit per-fold -> khong them be mat leakage; nhuong xac minh cho monitor plan (pass-rate vs 30%).
cap_rule.rejected_alternative: Adaptive tau = max(1.0%, validation-margin-scale): LOAI vi (a) cung tau scale CA target lan pred trong ListNet v55 -> lam phang phan bo target, doi objective hoc (khong con la v55 + 1 change sach); (b) khong bound test-time margins (threshold van gap raw scale -> giu nguyen lo hong shift); (c) tham so fit per-fold them be mat leakage/phuc tap vs hang so co dinh.
cap_rule.disclosure: CAP=3.0 la guardrail phong ngua pre-spec (chua co trained-logit quan sat: v55 ERROR truoc khi co output); neu audit cho thay cap dormant (|raw|<<3 moi noi) thi ghi nhan dormant + monitor plan la chinh, KHONG refit CAP theo test.
